content: Resend domain verification: add domain in Resend dashboard, add generated DKIM (TXT), SPF (TXT/MX) records at the sending subdomain (not root domain) with exact values Resend provides; DNS propagation up to 24-48h. DMARC is a separate TXT record the sender configures independently (Resend doesn't auto-generate it) recommended policy p=none initially, tightened to quarantine/reject after monitoring.
